description: extension.ex:12 — handler_fn type uses named parameters in a way that Elixir parses as a single-arg function taking a tuple, not a two-arg function. Change to: @type handler_fn :: (map(), OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Context.t() -> term()). Not a runtime bug but would produce confusing Dialyzer results.
title: Fix handler_fn type parenthesization in Extension
